title: PR #15 — Vault list, minimal create, filters, and keyboard navigation
description: Render the decrypted vault list with sorting, filtering, keyboard navigation, and a minimal encrypted create path, all computed in memory over cached ciphertext. Requirement IDs: TASK-38, plus the minimal-create slice of TASK-40. Search is TASK-39 and full editors are TASK-40/41.
acceptanceCriteria: List rows show decrypted name, username (if login), folder, favorite, and type
Sorting by name and updated-at works; filtering by type, folder, and favorite works and combines
Keyboard navigation supports arrow keys, j/k, roving tabindex, and Enter to open
An empty vault shows a working CTA that creates a minimal named login or note
Minimal creates encrypt locally, enqueue through the outbox, appear optimistically, and sync when online
A 500-item projection renders without blocking input or failing
Every action is reachable by keyboard alone

steps.details: Create app/lib/vault/item-payload.ts with strict login/note/folder payload schemas. Create app/lib/vault/projection.ts that opens cached envelopes with the in-memory key, decrypts folders first, uses bounded concurrency, skips corrupt rows, and zeros the key copy.

Keep app/routes/vault-list.tsx transport-only. Implement the page entry and container under app/features/vault-list/ with components/, vault-list.hooks.ts, and vault-list.lib.ts. Use a single list with a read-only detail dialog rather than a two-pane placeholder.

Add sort by name/updated and combined type/folder/favorite filters. Keep the preference in session state; persistence is deferred and recorded in the design. Apply filters before sorting and memoize the visible rows.
Use a roving tabindex list with ArrowUp/ArrowDown, j/k, Enter to open, and focus restoration after the detail dialog closes. Shortcuts must not fire in editable or interactive controls.

Add a dialog for name, type, folder, and favorite. Validate the payload schema, seal it with the vault key, write an optimistic cache row plus outbox entry, refresh the list, and flush. Normalize standard base64 cache ciphertext to base64url at the HTTP boundary.

steps.description: Add empty, loading, offline, and error states
steps.details: Empty vault shows the create CTA. Loading uses skeletons. Offline/error banners keep cached rows visible and expose retry. Corrupt rows are counted without blanking the list.
Add a 500-row projection test and Playwright coverage for create, filters, detail, lock/unlock, note creation, 360px layout, and offline create followed by reconnect.

technicalNotes: Decrypt only what is needed; do not keep decrypted objects in a global store longer than necessary.
Search must never hit the server; it moves to TASK-39.
Virtualize the list only if measurement shows it is needed; 500 rows are acceptable for this slice.
Keyboard shortcuts must be inert inside editable fields and must not override button activation.
Folder names are ciphertext too; decrypt them with the same projection layer.
Search and Ctrl/Cmd+K are out of scope; TASK-39 owns them.

pullRequest.title: feat(vault): list, filters, keyboard navigation, and minimal create
pullRequest.scope: Payload schemas, decrypt projection, list surface, sort/filter state, keyboard navigation, read-only detail, minimal encrypted create, offline outbox flush, tests.
pullRequest.outOfScope: Search palette and Ctrl/Cmd+K (TASK-39), full item fields, update/delete, unsaved guard (TASK-40/41), folder management, generator, TOTP UI, clipboard/reveal, responsive hardening.
